title: Stop guessing between sessions

slides.title: You changed ten things. Nothing got faster.
slides.body: Between sessions, fix the corner that costs you most.

slides.title: Guessing wastes your next session
slides.body: After a session everything feels slow. You change your braking, your line and your gears at once, and learn nothing.

slides.title: Look where you are losing the most
Pick one corner. Change one thing.
slides.body: The Pit view ranks your three costliest corners and shows your brake points lap by lap. Start with the top one.

slides.title: Then check it corner by corner
Follow TRACE to be first when it launches.

caption:
Between sessions, most beginners change everything at once.
Fix one corner instead: the one costing you most.
Track days only.
